/bin/zsh -lc 'set -eu
RUN_ROOT="$PWD/.runtime-evidence/t1512-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
mkdir -p "$RUN_ROOT"
printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$RUN_ROOT" > .runtime-evidence/t1512-latest-run-root.txt
git clone --no-tags --filter=blob:none git@github.com:oopslink/agent-center.git "$RUN_ROOT/fresh-clone"
cd "$RUN_ROOT/fresh-clone"
git fetch origin main
git checkout --detach 1a8a55e9e9b862c15c05300689c1b08cd328df7d
git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short --branch
make build'
/bin/zsh -lc 'RUN_ROOT=$(cat .runtime-evidence/t1512-latest-run-root.txt); cd "$RUN_ROOT/fresh-clone" && git status --short --branch && git rev-parse HEAD || true && git sparse-checkout list || true'
/bin/zsh -lc 'RUN_ROOT=$(cat .runtime-evidence/t1512-latest-run-root.txt); cd "$RUN_ROOT/fresh-clone" && git restore --source=HEAD --worktree --staged :/ && git status --short --branch && make build'

/bin/zsh -lc 'set -eu
RUN_ROOT=$(cat .runtime-evidence/t1512-latest-run-root.txt)
LOCAL_CLONE="$RUN_ROOT/fresh-clone-local-$(date -u +%H%M%S)"
printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$LOCAL_CLONE" > "$RUN_ROOT/fresh-clone-path.txt"
git clone --no-hardlinks "$PWD" "$LOCAL_CLONE"
cd "$LOCAL_CLONE"
git remote set-url origin git@github.com:oopslink/agent-center.git
git fetch origin main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "1a8a55e9e9b862c15c05300689c1b08cd328df7d"
git checkout --detach 1a8a55e9e9b862c15c05300689c1b08cd328df7d
git status --short --branch
make build'
